items.title: Kent Jordan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 22, 2006
items.q: He just called John Murtaugh and said yeah, give Kent the arrangements.

ctx.x: Well actually he gave me all of the arrangements off of that CD. And I performed tunes like “Pensativa,” John Murtaugh did “Equinox,” “Motherless Child.” He just called John Murtaugh and said yeah, give Kent the arrangements. And I performed some of those things when I do the flute and string combination. I’ll send you the concert, I did it live, so you can hear it.
That’s great. And he doesn’t — did I hear something that he doesn’t perform in clubs anymore or something like that?
